title: Finding
description: One detected problem in a target document. Identity is content-anchored (rule + kind + normalized anchor text), never line-number-anchored, so it survives re-validation after a partial fix shifts subsequent lines.

kind.description: Namespaced category, '<namespace>/<name>'. Core namespace is 'core'; profile kinds use the profile id. See references/schemas/kinds.md.

rule.description: The rule file and rule code this finding violates, e.g. 'rules-workflow-quality-control.md#W6'.

path.description: Workspace-relative path. Never absolute; never contains '..'.

section.description: Human-readable location within the file (heading, step name, or similar).

line_hint.description: Advisory display-only line number. Never part of finding identity and never used for re-validation.

anchor.description: Verbatim excerpt copied from the target file. Required: derive_finding_id.py rejects any finding whose anchor cannot be found in the target by normalized substring search (reason_code anchor_not_found). This is both the re-validation mechanism and a mechanical injection-containment gate — a finding that cannot quote real target text is refused.

violation.description: Plain-language explanation of what is wrong.

suggested_change.description: A structured, bounded edit span. Never free prose — render_diff.py turns this into a literal unified diff for human review; prose suggestions are not accepted by the schema.

before.description: Verbatim text to be replaced. Must be found in the target or render_diff.py returns blocked.
